newsitem.title: USA: RTW blames higher claims for Q4 net drop.
newsitem.headline: RTW blames higher claims for Q4 net drop.

text.p: RTW Inc said Thursday significantly higher claims and a charge related to an increase in its excess of loss reinsurance limit caused a decline in net income in the fourth quarter.
The company reported earnings of $1.6 million, or $0.13 a share, in the period ended December 31, compared to $2.5 million, or $0.20 a share, one year ago.
Total revenues were $18.6 million, versus $12.8 million in the fourth quarter of 1995.
The company said it experienced the four largest claims in its history, worth about $2.0 million, in the fourth quarter.
RTW provides workers' compensation management services to employers.
Its shares closed up 1/4 Thursday at 14-1/2.
